_comment: Separation timing (HR-driven identity guide, Gate 6). The thresholds are the agency's organization-defined periods for PS-4 (sample values; the agency approves or replaces them). The card rule is FIPS 201-3's: a card that can't be collected is terminated within 18 hours of notification (Book 03, Chapter 09). The catch-up window is Learn's: a scheduled workflow still processes a user whose trigger date passed no more than three days ago.
